upcoming_events.title: MKAF Festival of the Arts
upcoming_events.description: A two-day juried fine art festival at the Mattie Kelly Cultural Arts Village, Saturday 9 AM–5 PM and Sunday 10 AM–4 PM, with artists from around the region, live music and food vendors · free to attend · 35-min drive west.

upcoming_events.title: Halloweener Derby & Costume Contest
upcoming_events.description: Saturday Oct 24, 10 AM–2 PM at the Seaside Amphitheater · dachshund races down Central Square and an all-breeds costume contest · free to watch, bring the dog and a camera · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Seeing Red Wine Festival
upcoming_events.description: A vintners dinner at Bud & Alley's, the Al Fresco Reserve Tasting, Battle of the Somms, the Grand Tasting in Central Square, and a Celebration of Bubbles brunch · benefits DCWAF · tickets at seasideseeingred.com · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: WaterColor Mountainfilm on Tour
upcoming_events.description: 26th year of the tour · two nights of award-winning documentary shorts on adventure, environment and culture, straight from the Mountainfilm festival in Telluride, outdoors at the Marina Park Amphitheater · gates 5:45 PM, films at 7 PM · 10-min drive west

upcoming_events.title: Alys Beach Crafted
upcoming_events.description: A five-day craft and culinary weekend — the Firkin Fête, the Spirited Soirée, mixology dinners and seminars, and the Holiday Makers Market, daily 10 AM–10 PM · benefits the Cultural Arts Alliance of Walton County · 15-min drive east

upcoming_events.title: Rosemary Beach Uncorked
upcoming_events.description: 15th annual · Saturday Nov 14, 2026, 1–4 PM on Barrett Square · wines poured by vintners from around the world alongside dishes from ten Rosemary Beach restaurants, with live music as you stroll the cobblestone streets · $225 general admission, $350 VIP · 15-min drive east

upcoming_events.title: Morning Vinyasa Yoga
upcoming_events.description: Through Oct 31 · Daily 8:30 AM · Every morning at 8:30 AM on the pavilion overlooking the Gulf, weather permitting · no preregistration, $25 drop-in by cash, check, or Venmo · bring a mat or towel and water · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Central Square Cinema
upcoming_events.description: Through Oct 30 · Fri 8 PM · Free family movies on the big screen at the Seaside Amphitheater, Fridays at 8 PM — Coco (Oct 23) and a Halloween feature (Oct 30) · bring a blanket and the kids · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: Seaside Farmers Market
upcoming_events.description: Year-Round · Sat 9–1 · Saturdays year-round, 9 AM–1 PM at the Seaside Amphitheater, with a second Tuesday market added each June and July · local growers, artisan cheeses and breads, craft chefs, and live acoustic music · 5-min walk or drive

upcoming_events.title: 30A Farmers' Market
upcoming_events.description: Year-Round · Sun 9–1 · About 30 vendors on Barrett Square every Sunday, 9 AM–1 PM — local produce and micro-greens, Gulf seafood off the boat, artisan breads and sweets, grass-fed beef, tupelo honey · pet-friendly · a great Sunday-morning outing · 15-min drive east

copy.instagram:
MKAF Festival of the Arts lands this weekend in Destin — two days of juried art, live music and food vendors, free to walk through, 35 minutes west.

Blue Moon is open Fri Oct 23 – Sun 25, three nights.

Art in the afternoon, three king bedrooms and a quiet lane to come home to.

Book direct — link in bio.
copy.facebook: The MKAF Festival of the Arts runs Saturday and Sunday at the Mattie Kelly Cultural Arts Village in Destin — free to attend, about 35 minutes west — and Blue Moon is open Fri Oct 23 through Sun 25, three nights. Spend the day among the artists and come back to a quiet street in Seagrove, with the public beach access at Pelayo a three-minute walk across Scenic 30A. Live availability and real prices at https://book.sunandmoon30a.com
